marketplace.name: skillmcp
marketplace.description: Provider- and surface-agnostic skills marketplace. One repo, installable in Claude Code, Claude Cowork, claude.ai, ChatGPT, and Codex.

plugins.name: skillmcp
plugins.description: Install this once: browse, search, try, submit and install SkillMCP skills from inside your assistant.

skills.name: browse-skillmcp
skills.description: Browse, search, preview and install skills from the SkillMCP marketplace using the skillmcp MCP tools. Use when the user asks to find a skill, browse the marketplace, "is there a skill for X", or wants to install a skill on this surface.

claude-ai: Customize → Plugins → + (Personal plugins) → Add from a repository → https://github.com/derandomized/skillmcp

plugins.name: hello-skillmcp
plugins.description: Smoke-test skill: confirms a SkillMCP install is live on any surface.

skills.name: hello-skillmcp
skills.description: Smoke-test skill that proves a SkillMCP-distributed skill is installed and active. Use when the user says "hello skillmcp", asks to test SkillMCP, or wants to confirm a marketplace install worked on this surface.

claude-ai: Customize → Plugins → + (Personal plugins) → Add from a repository → https://github.com/derandomized/skillmcp

plugins.name: commit-haiku
plugins.description: Summarize a diff or PR as a 5-7-5 haiku plus a plain one-liner.

skills.name: commit-haiku
skills.description: Summarize a code change, diff, or pull request as a three-line haiku (5-7-5 syllables) followed by a one-sentence plain summary. Use when the user asks for a commit haiku, a poetic diff summary, or says "haiku this change".

claude-ai: Customize → Plugins → + (Personal plugins) → Add from a repository → https://github.com/derandomized/skillmcp

plugins.name: explain-like-a-pirate
plugins.description: Technically accurate explanations in a friendly pirate voice.

skills.name: explain-like-a-pirate
skills.description: Re-explain any technical concept, error message, or piece of code in the voice of a friendly pirate while keeping the explanation technically accurate. Use when the user asks to "explain like a pirate", "pirate mode", or wants a playful but correct explanation.

claude-ai: Customize → Plugins → + (Personal plugins) → Add from a repository → https://github.com/derandomized/skillmcp
